claims.fact: This prequel to 2002's Grand Theft Auto: Vice City centers around the former soldier Vic Vance and his attempts to build up a criminal empire with his brother Lance in early ‘80s Vice City.

claims.fact: The Official US PlayStation Magazine deemed Vice City “the PS2's defining title,” while a reviewer for Maxim magazine (holy 2002!) said, “You’ll be sold the second you get into a gang bang with the song “Beat It” playing in the background.
